active_goal: Implement and package Phase 4 P4.2 / 0.4.0-phase4-dev2: a bounded persistent chunk-column hierarchy plus conservative coarse GPU visibility, while retaining promoted P4.1 section visibility as the fine shadow control and P3.10 as production terrain owner.
scope_boundary: Active engineering scope is P4.2 column hierarchy/coarse GPU visibility plus required continuity/release maintenance. Do not add production GPU-driven draw ownership, real terrain command compaction, native graphics expansion, temporal occlusion, Hi-Z, indirect-count consumption, P3.9 partial remeshing, or unrelated renderer scope.

facts.text: Phase 3 is complete. P4.1 is promoted COMPLETE and remains shadow-only; P3.10 still owns production SOLID/CUTOUT terrain rendering.

P4.2 is active on draft PR #75 with frozen A-0224 contract and version target 0.4.0-phase4-dev2. It adds bounded persistent chunk-column hierarchy plus conservative coarse GPU visibility while keeping P4.1 as the fine section-level control.
Repository hygiene is active and proven; the normal steady state is main plus active PR branches, with a target of no more than five branches.
The public tester channel for development binaries is GitHub Prerelease / Preview; v0.4.0-phase4-dev1 is published as a Preview.

The Context Governor is active and proven: PR #61 exact head passed hosted Build and Context Governor CI, merged [no-release], and the merged main commit passed Context Governor, Build, and Repository Hygiene workflows.

Root TIMELINE.md is a maintained public visual history/index governed by D-0030 and REPOSITORY_HYGIENE.md; it must track material phase/milestone/history changes but never overrides authoritative engineering sources.

The Modrinth mirror is proven end to end. Publish Preview run #5 (36434577563) and Modrinth job 108969491205 succeeded; the 404 read fallback continued to VERSION_CREATE and published 0.4.0-phase4-dev1 as Modrinth version OhTxTs7Z from exact Preview source 6af5174f054b272c65174fbf0c37d981a66aff31.

decisions.text: Native Vulkan interop stays narrow; Minecraft continues to own the Vulkan device, queues, submission lifecycle, swapchain/presentation, and normal graphics passes unless a separately evidenced decision changes that boundary.
main is the only permanent branch; branches are disposable working state and history belongs in attempts, PRs, exact SHAs, tags, and releases.

LLM context is tiered and recoverable; compact summaries are non-authoritative indexes, critical knowledge must survive compaction, and external calls/OAuth authorization are limited to task-necessary data and least-privilege scopes.

The public project timeline is a governed non-authoritative history index; material phase/milestone transitions, promotions/rejections/deferments, major project-wide operating capabilities, and roadmap-arc changes trigger synchronization.

Modrinth mirrors eligible GitHub Stable/Preview builds without changing package authority; credentials remain GitHub Actions runtime secrets and publication channels map from Obsidian version markers under D-0031.

open_obligations.text: Implement A-0224 exactly: persistent bounded column hierarchy maintained from the same section lifecycle/resync truth, structural audits, coarse GPU classifier, independent CPU oracle, scale/candidate-reduction telemetry, and no production ownership change.

Run exact hosted CI on dev2, package/publish a Preview when CI-green, then collect the frozen reference runtime with render distance 32+ when practical, F3+T/re-entry/lifetime checks and explicit human visual PASS before promotion.

security_boundaries.text: Never store credentials, access tokens, private keys, cookies, passwords, or other secrets in the repository or AI continuity files.
External API, connector, MCP, and OAuth calls must receive only task-necessary fields/scopes; unrelated conversation history and available-but-unneeded data are excluded.
Never persist, print, hash, or otherwise expose the Modrinth PAT; GitHub Actions injects it only from repository secret MODRINTH_PAT at runtime.
